note: The PAC buffer count is read directly from the input header and controls subsequent header-size and loop calculations.
A very large input-controlled cbuffers value can overflow the header length calculation, so the required PAC_INFO_BUFFER bytes are not represented by header_len.
Because header_len has wrapped to a small value, the short candidate passes the length check instead of being rejected.
The overflowed admission lets the parser enter a loop whose bound is the huge input-controlled buffer count.
The loop reads the first PAC_INFO_BUFFER field from p even though the candidate contains no complete buffer descriptor past the header, producing an out-of-bounds read.
